_comment: Hand-authored half of the portfolio mesh. Judgement lives here; numbers do not.
Anything countable from the filesystem (skills, agents, commands, schemas) is
derived by scripts/mesh-generate.mjs and must NOT be written here — that is the
mistake portfolio-mesh.yaml v0.1.0 made, and it went stale in five days.
Numbers that are real but not yet under the counting contract live in a repo's
curated_metrics block with an explicit as_of date, so their age is visible.
Edit this file, then run: npm run mesh:generate
